innovation.title: What exactly is Luxor?
innovation.p1: Luxor (LXR) is a utility token that functions as the access key to the Luxor Ecosystem.
innovation.p2: The ecosystem brings together applications, services, and tools designed to help individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and enterprises access a new digital economy with more efficient and accessible products and services.
innovation.p3: LXR connects the user with the different solutions in the ecosystem, including Royalty, our multichain decentralized neobank; USDX, our stablecoin; artificial intelligence tools; corporate services; payment and digital asset infrastructure; and future RWA solutions.

philosophy.title: What is Luxor used for?
philosophy.subtitle: LXR allows you to access and use the different applications and services of the Luxor Ecosystem.

items.desc: Access ecosystem products and services at more efficient prices.
Use Royalty, our multichain decentralized neobank and its wallet.
Access USDX, our stablecoin designed to offer greater stability within the digital economy.
Use artificial intelligence tools for personal and business use.
Create, manage, and scale projects and businesses through our digital tools.
Access our payment infrastructure and create digital assets representing projects or companies.
Participate in future Real World Asset (RWA) opportunities within the ecosystem.
Use LXR as the utility asset that connects the different Luxor applications and services.

philosophy.outro: In short: LXR is the token that gives you access to the ecosystem and its various utilities.

architecture.title: How to acquire Luxor?
architecture.subtitle: Luxor can be acquired from any wallet that supports Luxor, is compatible with the Solana network, or any blockchain where the token is deployed.

items.title: 1. Create or use a Solana-compatible wallet.
items.desc: You can use a wallet that allows you to store and operate with SPL tokens.

items.title: 2. Acquire LXR.
items.desc: Buy or exchange LXR using a compatible platform or market. Some of the wallets where you will always find it and can download on any device are Phantom or Royalty.

items.title: 3. Connect your wallet to the Luxor Ecosystem.
items.desc: Once you have LXR, you can use it to access the applications, products, and services available within the ecosystem.

architecture.outro: LXR — One token. One ecosystem. A new digital economy.

vital.title: Why is it vital to do this now?
vital.desc: The world is at an inflection point. Technology is no longer an option; it's the language of survival. While other regions fragment, the American Hemisphere rises as a beacon of unexplored synergy. For years, the gap between capital and talent has limited our collective potential. Luxor is here to bridge that gap, creating a unified digital infrastructure from Salt Lake City to the farthest corners of the Americas.

items.title: A Unified Economic Block
items.desc: Demographics is destiny. While other global powers face aging populations and stagnation, the Americas pulse with young, digital-native energy. By aligning the US innovation model with talent across the hemisphere, we're not just building a network; we're building the most resilient and dynamic economic block on the planet.

items.title: Hemispheric Stability
items.desc: Security through prosperity. A prosperous hemisphere is a secure hemisphere. Luxor facilitates the flow of digital utility and tools across borders, eradicating the lack of opportunity that breeds instability. We are replacing borders with bridges, ensuring the 'American Dream' of technological progress is a shared reality for everyone in our hemisphere.

items.title: Exponential Value Creation
items.desc: Leveraging AI and Robotics. We are transitioning from an economy of scarcity to one of abundance. Luxor ensures the Americas won't just witness the AI revolution, but lead it. From Silicon Slopes to every city on the continent, we provide the liquidity engine for the skilled workforce and creative minds behind tomorrow's algorithms.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.subtitle: A Future of Limitless Collaboration
vision.desc1: The United States has proven that an ecosystem based on freedom and innovation can generate global wealth with 350 million inhabitants. At Luxor, we ask a bold question: What could this model achieve if integrated with the human potential of the over 650 million inhabitants of Latin America?
vision.desc2: We don't simply seek profit; we seek the extension of prosperity to the entire hemisphere. We want to turn Latin America into the ultimate strategic partner, transforming a region of immense potential into a growth engine that doubles the capabilities of the global economy. Imagine a continent where the next tech unicorn is born not only in Silicon Valley but also in the connected minds of Medellín, Mexico City, or Buenos Aires, operating under the same standard of global excellence.

items.desc: Luxor deploys a Web3 infrastructure on Solana designed to orchestrate automated services and workflows. Our model implements a closed-loop economy where each asset fulfills a specific technical function, ensuring the network is used for its purpose: the efficient exchange of value and services.

items.title: Advancements and Operability
points: Core Infrastructure: Main architecture developed and in the final integration phase.
Governance Structure: Operational model based on a DAO for transparent management of ecosystem resources.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers regarding security, compliance, and processes.

items.q: How do I apply for the private sale?
items.a: The process begins with an application via email. Following profile verification (KYC), you will receive final instructions to secure your position and make the deposit into our Multisig treasury.

items.q: When will I receive my first tokens?
items.a: There is no single TGE; unlocking is monthly. Starting January 2, 2027, you can transparently claim your tokens on Streamflow, following the release schedule chosen in your plan.

items.q: What happens if the Soft Cap is not reached?
items.a: The Soft Cap is $500,000. In case it is not reached, Luxor will activate reserve funds to ensure the operability of the infrastructure and network deployment, always protecting the vision of the initial participants.

items.q: How do hardware and AI connect with the token?
items.a: The $LXR token is the 'gas' needed for the Roosevelt AI to process automated operations and allows Smart Glasses to interact autonomously with the network for the exchange of services.

items.q: When does this private sale end?
items.a: It officially ends on October 31, 2026. It is essential to complete your participation before this date to secure private sale conditions before the public Pinksale launch.
